svg.text: One case store, three front ends, verified end to end
Source evidence is opened read-only. Everything after capture is derived, versioned, and checkable.

g.text: Source evidence — read-only
Filesystem trees · JSONL · syslog 3164/5424 · journal export · browser stores · Windows EVTX
Never modified, never interpreted: an access-time side effect is disclosed, not asserted away.
Capture — protected copy, hashed, with a coverage ledger
protected-copy or explicit live-best-effort · every omission coded · acquisition manifest
Content-addressed object store: SHA-256 over copied bytes, deduplicated, immutable.
Case store — SQLite, versioned schema, WAL
acquisitions + manifests · parse runs · raw observations · events + time values
entities + bounded relationships · findings · append-only annotation revisions
Interpretations are separate rows, so a re-analysis never rewrites a recorded observation.
Risky adapters run in an isolated worker: setsid, no_new_privs, rlimits, 4-byte framed protocol.
Analysis
5 compiled rules with recorded
predicates + named alternatives
bounded entity correlation
no scores, no probabilities
Investigation
timeline, FTS search, histogram
snapshot diff · relationships
notes, tags, dispositions
append-only revisions, conflicts reported
Three front ends over one service contract
ghosttrace (CLI, JSON stdout / exit 0 1 2 3 4) · ghosttrace tui · ghosttrace-desktop (glow | wgpu)
The render pass never touches SQLite or evidence: work leaves through a worker, results carry generations.
Integrity and portability
Manifests signed over exact stored bytes (Ed25519, PBES2-encrypted key) · verification separates
byte integrity, signature validity, and key trust · portable packages with a SHA-256 inventory
Consistent snapshots for backup and restore; every restored byte is re-hashed before publication.

svg.text: No telemetry, no uploads, no URL fetching, no listeners unless explicitly enabled — a forensic tool that phones home is a forensic tool you cannot rely on.
